name: MenuTrigger
description: Button that opens the menu when clicked. Renders a `<button>` element.

props.name: children
props.description: Content shown inside the trigger, such as a label or an icon.

props.name: className
props.description:
CSS class applied to the element, or a function that
returns a class based on the component's state.

props.name: style
props.description:
Style applied to the element, or a function that
returns a style object based on the component's state.

props.name: closeDelay
props.description:
How long to wait before closing the menu that was opened on hover.
Specified in milliseconds.

Requires the `openOnHover` prop.

props.name: delay
props.description:
How long to wait before the menu may be opened on hover. Specified in milliseconds.

Requires the `openOnHover` prop.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the component should ignore user interaction.

props.name: handle
props.description: A handle to associate the trigger with a menu.

props.name: nativeButton
props.description:
Whether the component renders a native `<button>` element when replacing it
via the `render` prop.
Set to `false` if the rendered element is not a button (for example, `<div>`).

props.name: openOnHover
props.description: Whether the menu should also open when the trigger is hovered.

props.name: payload
props.description: A payload to pass to the menu when it is opened.

props.name: render
props.detailedType: ReactElement | ((props: HTMLProps, state: Menu.Trigger.State) => ReactElement) | undefined
props.description:
Allows you to replace the component's HTML element
with a different tag, or compose it with another component.

Accepts a `ReactElement` or a function that returns the element to render.
